scope: Kaggle v4 recovery and diagnostic changes; not a verified full 7B GPU run.
observed_user_failure: The v3 launcher exited with code 1. Its underlying GPU-stage error was not supplied, so its root cause is still unknown.
changes: A failed optional review output validation can retain the already validated draft, with completed=false and its validation errors saved. It is not relabeled as a successful review.
CUDA, model-loading and other runtime failures remain errors. Invalid base answers are not fabricated into successful rows.
The official CSV validator and a generation receipt check the full prediction file before it is published.
The completed CSV is published before the separate evaluation stage. A late evaluation failure does not mark that evaluation complete or discard valid predictions.
Inner notebook exceptions and stage logs print automatically with credential redaction.
The result ZIP retains available predictions, traces, executed cells and diagnostic logs.
No changes were made to Part 2, Part 3, original course documents, competition questions or candidate reference answers.
limitations: Local fixture and clean-folder CPU tests cannot certify CUDA compatibility, full runtime or answer quality.
The actual cause of the user's v3 failure requires its saved notebook or log.
A 0.8/0.9 leaderboard score, a completely error-free GPU run and completion within 90 minutes are not guaranteed.
